name: Composite
summary: Composes objects into tree structures to represent part-whole hierarchies, and lets clients treat individual objects and compositions uniformly.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Component
roles.summary: Declares the interface shared by the leaves and the composites of the tree.

roles.name: Leaf
roles.summary: A terminal element of the tree: it has no children.

roles.name: Composite
roles.summary: An element that holds other components and delegates the work to them.
